title: Extended Body Propagators
summary: Three seemingly distinct extended-body propagators devised by Ansoldi et al., Erbin et al., and Stanford et al.\ respectively arise in completely different settings, though each can be considered a realization of the Polyakov path integral. This paper proves that the Ansoldi propagator corresponds to the characteristic function of the random variable with the probability density function $f(A)=C\,A\,(α^{2}+A^{2})^{-D/2}\mathbf{1}_{A>0}$ in ambient dimension $D$, of scale $α=\sqrt{b/2}$.
